name: hyperframes-three-kit
description: Kit 3D (three.js + postprocessing) para composicoes HyperFrames, guiado pelo tempo da timeline.

scripts.demo:prepare: mkdir -p examples/demo/assets && cp dist/hf3d.mjs examples/demo/assets/ && cp fonts/*.woff examples/demo/assets/
scripts.demo: npm run demo:prepare && cd examples/demo && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.181 render --quality draft -o demo.mp4
